text:
ana: Starting regional rollout plan for v2.14.0 — coordination thread. Change windows below.

mike: TL;DR: US canary -> EU canary -> APAC canary, pin EU if capacity <20%.

jia: noted. what are the windows?

ana: (typo) @jia -> ana: windows are: US 10:00-12:00 PT, EU 14:00-16:00 UTC, APAC 02:00-04:00 HKT. canaries 5% each.

marcus: capacity quick-checks completed just now: US headroom ~32%, EU ~17%, APAC ~25%. details: `cpu/gpu allocation + queue depth`.

mike: EU at 17% is below our soft threshold. suggest pinned rollout for EU to v2.13.8 until we free capacity or expand Dedicated pool.

ana: Agree. Decision: proceed with US canary, delay EU canary and keep EU pinned to v2.13.8. APAC proceed only after US stability check.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 1758123460 — canary US @5% -> image: redwood/inference:v2.14.0-canary

oncall-bot: Note: oncall rotation for the window: @mike primary, @jia backup. Pager thresholds unchanged.

mike: kickoff in 5. watching metrics. rollback criteria: error-rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline.

jia: logging quick smoke test steps in case we need a fast rollback:
```
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
2) check logs: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime-canary-us -n inference --tail 200`
3) if errors: `deploy-bot rollback 1758123460`
```

marcus: US canary metrics at +10m: errors 0.3%, p95 +12ms, token throughput steady. CPU at 70% on canary nodes.

mike: looks healthy. ramping to 20% in US in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary updated: 1758123485 -> US canary at 20%

marcus: after ramp: errors 0.4%, p95 +18ms, queue depth minor spike but within SLO. Headroom US now ~25%.

jia: starting APAC canary now (5%). will monitor for 15m then report.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 1758123505 -> APAC 5% using same image.

marcus: APAC initial: errors 0.6%, p95 +30ms, headroom 22%. ok for now.

mike: status check: EU still pinned to v2.13.8. action items: ops to free 10% capacity in EU by 18:00 UTC or we push a limited EU rollout next maintenance window.

ana: ops ticket created: OPS-5891. ETA for capacity bump 6h. tagging infra leads. @marcus can you validate autoscale policies won't oversubscribe?

marcus: looked; autoscaler conservative, won't oversubscribe. but we'll need to extend Dedicated pool or shift some background jobs out.

mike: ok. if EU capacity not resolved, we'll schedule EU patch release v2.14.0-compat that reduces concurrency for EU only. prefer to avoid.

jia: note for release notes: mention EU pin and rollback criteria + change windows. I'll draft a short blurb.

ana: :thumbsup: Good run. final: US and APAC canaries progressed, EU pinned pending capacity bump. keeping this thread for tracing decisions and ops ticket link.

mike: closing loop — will reopen thread if rollback or new deploy. :white_check_mark:
